baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالَ ... هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ ... رُشْدًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken proposal joins following to teaching under a stated condition, forming an asymmetrical apprenticeship whose end is sound conduct rather than information alone.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over a matter makes the opening question a proposed apprenticeship compact.
Following and imitation supply the subordinate teacher-learner relation.
Disclosure to a knower makes teaching the intended transfer within that relation.
Sound handling of an affair gives the transfer a practical, conduct-shaping end.

changed_reading.before: Moses asks a knowledgeable person for useful information.
changed_reading.after: Moses proposes entering a governed apprenticeship in which following is the condition for acquiring sound practical judgment.

baseline_models.mechanism: Following can be a slow tracing of successive signs; teaching then cultivates recognition of marks that disclose a straight course.

activation_trace.role: Tracing one mark after another turns following into an investigative method.
A distinguishing mark that guides makes taught knowledge legible as signs.
The straight-path image gives those signs a directional end away from error.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an abstract answer delivered by a teacher.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is wayfinding competence acquired by following and learning to read discriminating marks.

baseline_models.mechanism: The active and passive teaching forms place the teacher inside a prior chain of disclosure, while مِمَّا asks for a share rather than exhaustive possession.

activation_trace.role: The same disclosure image governs both the teacher's prior receipt and the requested onward teaching.
Sound disposition limits the requested share by an operative end rather than total knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The addressee owns a body of knowledge that he may transmit.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is an intermediate recipient asked to relay a fitting portion of what first reached him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the request, reaching the sought encounter requires reversing course and tracking an enduring trace. The journey therefore gives concrete procedural force to the focus model of following as sign-reading.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise tracing is the focus-ayah method that the preceding journey enacts.
Returning something to its place supplies the reversal needed after passing the sought point.
A remaining sign of what was there makes prior footprints usable evidence.
Tracking an أثر supplies the actual procedure by which the encounter is recovered.

structural_cues: 18:61-64 sequences missed sign, recognition, reversal, and close retracing before 18:65's encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, residual marks, and trace-tracking; I infer that this outer search prefigures the requested learning method. A live alternative is that it only localizes the encounter in the plot.

changed_reading.before: Following a teacher may cultivate wayfinding in principle.
changed_reading.after: Moses asks to learn by the same discipline just enacted: notice what was missed, reverse when necessary, and recover the way from residual traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following becomes a temporal discipline: lack of encompassing inside-knowledge must be borne without immediate interrogation until the teacher elects to disclose the matter.

activation_trace.role: Following and imitation provide the relation whose conditions are subsequently specified.
Holding the self back from distress makes restraint, not passive duration, the learner's burden.
Complete cognitive enclosure names the knowledge the learner presently lacks.
Knowledge of a matter's interior distinguishes experienced grasp from surface reaction.
Making a thing manifest assigns the timing of disclosure to the teacher.

structural_cues: 18:67-68 ties inability to patience to lack of encompassing خبر.
18:70 makes following conditional on withholding questions until teacher-initiated mention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-encompassment, restraint, and teacher-timed disclosure; I infer a pedagogy in which premature questions freeze a still-unfolding event. Alternatively, the prohibition may be only contract management rather than a teaching method.

changed_reading.before: Following supplies proximity in which questions can obtain guidance.
changed_reading.after: Following first requires disciplined exposure to what cannot yet be encompassed; questioning becomes legitimate only after the event has ripened for disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The acts arrive in sequence before their intelligibility; only at separation are they reported back to their outcomes. Teaching thus works retrospectively, converting endured anomalies into causal judgment.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the later explanation as fulfillment of the requested teaching.
Distinguishing and separating mark the threshold at which companionship gives way to explanation.
News that arrives and is conveyed supplies the delayed explanatory report.
Return to a matter's outcome relocates meaning from first appearance to eventual consequence.
One thing following another makes the ordered succession of episodes part of the explanatory form.

structural_cues: 18:71-77 repeats act, objection, and warning three times before 18:78 announces separation and تأويل.
18:79-82 then reorder each troubling appearance by disclosing its consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed news, outcome-return, and sequential episodes; I infer a didactic arrow from enacted anomaly to retrospective intelligibility. A live alternative is that the closing account is merely a defense of the acts.

changed_reading.before: Teaching precedes action by stating the rule that should guide it.
changed_reading.after: Teaching may stage opaque action first and disclose its rule through consequences only afterward, so sequence and delay are themselves instructional.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus passive 'you were taught' expands into a delegated chain: the teacher is identified through obedient servanthood, receives knowledge from beyond himself, and denies acting from his own authority.

activation_trace.role: Prior disclosure to the teacher anchors the focus request in received rather than self-originated knowledge.
Submissive obedience makes the knowledgeable guide accountable within a higher relation.
Explicit teaching from 'Us' resolves the focus passive as a prior grant of knowledge.
Authority and its holder clarify the denial that the acts arose from the teacher's own command.

structural_cues: 18:65 frames the teacher as one of 'Our servants' and both mercy and knowledge as grants 'from Us.'
18:82 denies that the actions were done from the teacher's own command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received knowledge, servant status, and non-self-originated command; I infer that authority constrains both the content and exercise of what can be taught. Alternatively, these clauses may describe status and action without defining pedagogy.

changed_reading.before: Moses asks an expert to share a portion of his expertise.
changed_reading.after: Moses asks entry into a delegated trust: the guide may transmit and enact only what he himself has received under authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explanations align sound disposition with protection across time: damage blocks coercive seizure, substitution averts a feared burden, and stored wealth remains covered until unsupported children reach strength. Timing, concealment, and controlled release become dimensions of rushd.

activation_trace.role: Sound handling of an affair, including mature disposition, anchors the focus request in competent stewardship.
Coercive unjust seizure makes apparent impairment function as protection of vulnerable workers' property.
One thing standing in place of another supplies a future-oriented remedy rather than restoration of the first state.
Children cut off from a caretaker identify the dependency that requires custodial delay.
Preserved stored wealth supplies the asset kept inaccessible for its owners.
Reaching full strength fixes the future threshold for rightful release and use.

structural_cues: 18:79 explains a visible defect by the confiscation it prevents.
18:80-82 couple feared future harm and protected orphan wealth with substitution, maturity, and delayed access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three future-directed protections; I infer a common custodial arrow in which limited present harm or withholding preserves a vulnerable interest. Alternatively, the three explanations may exemplify distinct judgments without one fiduciary model.

changed_reading.before: Rushd is general right guidance or prudent choice.
changed_reading.after: Rushd is timed custodial judgment: discern whose interest is exposed, what must be withheld or altered now, and when protected agency or property can safely emerge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts saying and teaching from verbal delivery toward material semiotics. It remains anchored in the focus branches for a thing's indicative 'speech' and a guiding mark, while the context supplies altered objects and delayed manifestation. Render it as an exploratory pedagogy of signs, not as a denial of the later verbal explanation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ ... تُعَلِّمَنِ, read through القول as indication and العلم as a distinguishing mark

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as its 'saying' permits nonverbal states to carry intelligible testimony.
A distinguishing mark that guides makes material alteration potentially instructional.
Later manifestation preserves the teacher's eventual act of making the marked matter explicit.
A literal breach supplies a conspicuous negative mark whose purpose is initially unreadable.
Restoring straightness supplies a contrary material mark whose hidden function also awaits explanation.

changed_reading.before: Moses asks to hear explanatory instruction while accompanying the teacher.
changed_reading.after: Moses may be asking to learn a language of events in which altered things first 'say' through marks and receive verbal exposition only later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because it uses the عيلم image of abundant gathered water under the focus root علم. It remains packet-anchored through the double علم and the immediately preceding confluence of two seas. Render it only as a material analogy for the requested portion of knowledge, never as the primary lexical sense of the focus verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ, activated by the علم branch of abundant water gathered in an عيلم

activation_trace.role: Abundant water gathered in a sea or well recasts received knowledge as pooled depth.
Joining what was separate into one gathered thing supplies the confluence that activates the water image.
Wide abundant water gives the contextual material analogue for the focus branch.

changed_reading.before: Teaching transfers a bounded item of knowledge from one mind to another.
changed_reading.after: The request may image teaching as drawing a navigable share from gathered depth at a confluence, with following needed to move through rather than exhaust it.

strongest_changes: Following becomes retracing: missed signs, reversal, and residual footprints define a method of learning.
Patience becomes epistemic restraint under non-encompassment until teacher-timed disclosure.
Teaching becomes retrospective: sequential anomalies are returned to their outcomes only at separation.
Rushd becomes timed custodianship of vulnerable interests, agency, and stored property.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots interlock unusually tightly with the pericope's form: ت ب ع is enacted as trace-following, the two علم forms become a delegated relay and a mark-reading practice, and the orphan-treasure ending concretizes the practical-disposition branch of رشد.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether delayed questioning is intrinsically pedagogical or only a condition for this companionship.
Whether the three final explanations support one custodial mechanism or several irreducible judgments.
The material-speech and gathered-water readings are packet-licensed analogies but remain branch-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.
